name: Talisman of Resilience — three mana choices
description: Activate the Talisman and restart this scenario for each of its three tap abilities. The colorless choice adds {C} without changing life. The black and green choices each add their named mana and deal 1 damage to the Talisman's controller, reducing life from 20 to 19. All three abilities add mana immediately without using the stack, and each taps the Talisman.
